senses.gloss: m. pl. אַוְרַנְסֵי, אַבְרַ׳ (ῥάμνος, rhamnus) a kind of prickly shrubs, used for medical purposes and carried in lengthy bundles (v. D. C. Gr. s. v., a. Sm. Ant. s. v.).
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 91b">Sabb. 91ᵇ</cite> <cite ref="A01338"><he>או׳</he></cite> ed. (Ms. M. <cite ref="A01133"><he>אב׳</he></cite>; Ar. <cite ref="A03203"><he>ארנסי</he></cite>). [As to <he>ור</he>, <he>בר</he> for aspirate r, v. Lidd. a. Scott, Gr. Lex, 7<sup>ᵗʰ</sup> ed. s. lit. P.]
